## REQ-PLT-001

**Minimum hardware of an OEC platform**

The edge computer of an OEC platform uses one of the processor architectures ARMv7, ARMv8 or amd64 and provides at least 1 GB RAM, at least 4 GB non-volatile memory and at least one available network interface. The memory sizes are the nominal sizes of the installed memory, with 1 GB = 10^9 octets.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: platform
- Refs: RIG 5.1, SF-092, SF-116
- Verification: d8, manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: RIG-5.1-7017a7e5, RIG-5.1-72877b76, RIG-5.1-937b5b97, RIG-5.1-b96535ec, RIG-5.1-ceba026b

> To achieve Open Industry 4.0 Alliance compliance, the hardware and software must meet several requirements.
> — RIG 5.1

> The processor architecture must be one of the supported processor architectures ARMv7, ARMv8, and amd64
> — RIG 5.1

> The edge computer must provide a minimum of 1 GB RAM (nominal size of the installed memory; 1 GB = 10^9 octets)
> — RIG 5.1

> The edge computer must provide a minimum of 4 GB non-volatile memory (eMMC, SD Card, SSD, HDD, …; nominal size of the installed memory; 1 GB = 10^9 octets)
> — RIG 5.1

> The edge computer must provide at least one available network interface (likely Ethernet interface, but LTE or similar might be possible too)
> — RIG 5.1

Notes: Each list item has its own "must" since SF-092 (a) was resolved. The non-volatile memory may be eMMC, SD card, SSD, HDD or similar. RIG 5.2 refers to these processor architectures (REQ-APP-001, SF-092 (d)). Since SF-116 the minimums are the nominal sizes of the installed memory (data sheet) in SI units, not what the operating system shows: a host that shows somewhat less than 10^9 / 4 · 10^9 octets may still comply, so D8 (T8-HST-04) leaves such values to a manual check against the data sheet.

## REQ-PLT-003

**Linux at the current patch level**

- Domain: platform · Applies to: platform

## REQ-PLT-004

**User and role management with granular access control**

The user interface of an OEC platform provides user and role management for access control, by which the access to the available services of the host system can be configured in a granular way.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: platform
- Refs: RIG 5.1, SF-092
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: RIG-5.1-bde7cf36, RIG-5.1-d0d75d7e

> The user interface of an Open Edge Computing platform must provide user and role management for access control.
> — RIG 5.1

> It must be possible to configure the access to available services of the host system in a granular way via the user and role management.
> — RIG 5.1

Notes: Both items have their own "must" since SF-092 (a) was resolved.

## REQ-PLT-009

**Distributed infrastructure**

The infrastructure of an OEC system may be distributed over several computing instances, e.g. one instance running the MQTT broker, another one the OEC Registry and further ones the containerized applications.

- Keyword: MAY
- Domain: platform · Applies to: platform
- Refs: RIG 5.1
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: RIG-5.1-8387aa07

> However, the infrastructure of an Open Edge Computing system may be distributed over several computing instances, e.g. one instance running the MQTT broker, another one running the OEC Registry and further ones running the containerized applications.
> — RIG 5.1

Notes: A D8 check therefore must not assume that broker, Registry and applications run on the same host.
